## Summary and General Analysis
- Sushang has a 33% chance to trigger "Sword Stance" on the final hit of her Skill, dealing an Physical Additional DMG to the enemy target.
- If the enemy target is Weakness Broken, "Sword Stance" is guaranteed to trigger and her SPD will be increased.
- Her Ultimate forces her to immediately take action and increases the amount of "Sword Stance" damage instances by 2. These extra instances deal half the damage of the original "Sword Stance" hit.

## Noteable Investments
 ### The Dahlia
- The Dahlia provides invaluable Break support that makes her a necessity for Break teams.

## Skill Point Usage
- Negative/Neutral at E1+
